Resolves #20418

No Engine test talks to a Memory Core any more. @tobiu, verbatim: "no engine test should ever need a real memory core. this violates the repo split. it is UBER expensive to do this."
- **Reverts #20410.** On every Brain-tier run, its `e2e-brain (archive)` job checked out and packed the Brain, then built four Brain services (Chroma, embedding, OIDC, Memory Core) to run two specs that take about 19 s. Also gone: `memoryCoreArchiveFixture.mjs` with its spec, the fixture binding, and the archive-URL selection.
- **Deletes `TransactionArchiveReplay.spec.mjs`,** which is archive from start to end.
- **Trims `DemoBDockTransactionsNL`.** Its save and replay steps go. Begin/stage/commit/list, undo/redo, the unknown-Group refusal and the legacy-stack check stay. With no archive step left, it runs in the ordinary Brain shards.
- **Removes `BRAIN_CAPABILITIES`,** the exclusion that held both specs pending re-entry. Without its only entry, nothing used the mechanism.

The Engine client's own save/replay methods keep their stubbed unit coverage (`InstanceServiceNamedTransaction.spec.mjs`). If the archive round trip is worth testing, that test belongs in the Brain.

Evidence: L2 (unit: selector and scope-classifier specs, the Engine unit suite) → L3 required for the trimmed `DemoBDockTransactionsNL` in a real browser. This PR's own Brain-gated tier runs it, since it is now selected. Residual: none beyond this PR's CI.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 (archive calls refuse in the e2e realm) | Superseded by the directive above, as recorded in the [intake](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20418#issuecomment-6683498274): no archive call remains in the e2e realm, so nothing is left to refuse. `git grep -E 'saveTransaction\|replayTransaction\|save_nl_transaction' -- test/playwright/e2e` finds 0 files; the control `listTransactions` finds 1. |
| AC-2 (red-proof of the refusal) | Superseded with AC-1: there is no refusal to red-proof. |
| AC-3 (configured path and hosted archive job green) | Superseded: the hosted archive job is removed. |
| AC-4 (a local DemoB run adds no `nl-transaction-archive` node) | Met by construction. The spec no longer calls `saveTransaction`, the only path that writes such a node. CI runs the trimmed spec in this PR's Brain-gated tier. |
| AC-5 (local disposable-archive recipe documented) | Superseded: the Engine no longer has an archive fixture to document. |

## Deltas from ticket

The ticket asked to isolate the archive client inside the e2e realm. The operator's directive moves the fix to the root instead, and the claimer's intake on #20418 records that change. #17844's re-entry trigger ("CI provisions a Memory Core archive and both files pass against it") is retired, not deferred.

- New arm "the full tier runs every Brain-gated file: none waits on a Memory Core": `brainSelection().paths` equals every Brain-gated file.
